en.quote: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
en.riddle: These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
en.speaker: Israel

he.quote: כִּי תֹאמַר בִּלְבָבְךָ רַבִּים הַגּוֹיִם הָאֵלֶּה מִמֶּנִּי אֵיכָה אוּכַל לְהוֹרִישָֽׁם
